profile.name: Srinivitha Kathirvel
profile.subTagline: Specializing in Embedded Systems, IoT Architectures, and C Programming.
profile.aboutText: I am a passionate Electronics and Communication Engineering student dedicated to bridging the gap between hardware complexity and software efficiency. My interests lie at Embedded system, Python, Java, IoT. Strong foundation along with hands-on experience through Soldering-based workshop and projects using Arduino and advancing in problem-solving. Passionate about IoT, Embedded systems and software-oriented roles, with a keen interest to apply theoretical concepts in the real-world systems.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Electronics & Communication
education.details: Specialized coursework in Digital Signal Processing, Analog & Digital Communications, Embedded Systems, and Electromagnetic Field Theory.
Focused on Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Computer Science.

projects.title: IoT-Enabled Smart Agricultural Drone
projects.description: Designed a custom quadcopter equipped with multispectral sensors and ESP32 nodes to monitor crop health, soil moisture, and micro-climatic metrics. Programmed remote telemetry using MQTT protocol to stream sensor readings into a web-based dashboard and integrated an on-board computer for autonomous waypoint flight navigation.

projects.title: Multi-Layer Smart Home Central Hub
projects.description: Engineered a low-power central IoT hub using a Raspberry Pi 4 coordinating STM32 battery-powered nodes scattered around the house. Nodes communicated over an encrypted sub-1GHz RF link (LoRa). The central gateway compiled data and displayed dashboard widgets using React, while logging entries into a local database.

certifications.title: Embedded Systems Engineering Professional Certificate
certifications.description: Comprehensive specialization covering real-time software development, ring buffers, memory architectures, serial protocols (SPI, I2C), and low-power hardware modes on ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers.

certifications.title: Introduction to Digital Signal Processing
certifications.description: Focused on discrete-time signals, Z-transforms, Fourier transforms (DFT/FFT), filter architectures, and practical signal filtering implementations in MATLAB.
